# Sqrt-1 (sqrt.fyi)

> Personal site of Sqrt-1, computer science undergrad at NSUT chasing the joy of building software. Home to his blog, small web toys, and notes on what he is learning and reading.

- [Curriculum Vitae](https://cv.sqrt.fyi/): Home, projects, skills, and about for Sqrt-1.

## Main Pages

- [Blog](https://sqrt.fyi/blog): Essays and writing by Sqrt-1 on programming, games, and whatever else he is thinking about.
- [Now](https://sqrt.fyi/now): What Sqrt-1 is currently learning, building, and reading.
- [Microblog](https://sqrt.fyi/microblog): Short thoughts, links, and updates fetched live from @sqrt-1.bsky.social on Bluesky.
- [Colophon](https://sqrt.fyi/colophon): How this site is built: the tools, fonts, and stack behind sqrt.fyi.
- [Questions](https://sqrt.fyi/questions): Open problems and puzzles Sqrt-1 is currently working through.
- [Contact](https://sqrt.fyi/contact): Ways to reach Sqrt-1.

## Feeds & Indexes

- [Atom Feed](https://sqrt.fyi/feed.xml): Full feed of blog posts.
- [Sitemap](https://sqrt.fyi/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all pages.

## Markdown Source

- [Blog](https://sqrt.fyi/blog): Blog listing page.
- Every blog post's raw Markdown source is available by appending `.md` to its URL, e.g. https://sqrt.fyi/blog/nonslop.md
